description: Beep when another CardputerZero running nearby is close

store.summary: Beeps when another Cardputer running Nearby is close
store.description:
Each CardputerZero running Nearby sends a small anonymous Bluetooth LE beacon and listens for the others. When one comes close it beeps and shows roughly how far away it is: right here, close, nearby or far.

Only devices running Nearby can see each other. The beacon uses a random address that changes every 15 minutes, so it can't be used to follow you around.

Press q to quit. Nearby uses sudo to talk to the Bluetooth chip directly. Source code is linked below.
